inputs.question: During 'Summer Beverages 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar, which product category had the highest total quantity sold? Return {category:str, quantity:int}.
During 'Summer Beverages 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar, which product category had the highest total quantity sold? Return {category:str, quantity:int}.

assumptions: 'summer beverages 2017' has two end dates in the corpus (2017-06-30 in marketing_calendar::chunk1, 2017-07-07 in campaign_memo::chunk0); the question pins the marketing calendar, so 2017-06-01..2017-06-30 was used and the revision was not applied.
outputs.constraints:
DATE WINDOW: date(OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-06-01' AND '2017-06-30' (inclusive; from marketing_calendar::chunk1)
  COLUMN: OrderDate is a column of Orders only
DATES: OrderDate mixes 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; always wrap it as date(OrderDate) so the closing day is not dropped.
ENTITY GRAIN: group by the entity's id column (CustomerID, CategoryID, ProductID, EmployeeID, SupplierID) and select its display name.
REVENUE uses "Order Details".UnitPrice, never Products.UnitPrice.

inputs.question: During 'Summer Beverages 2017' as defined in the marketing calendar, which product category had the highest total quantity sold? Return {category:str, quantity:int}.

outputs.sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.Quantity) q FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=p.CategoryID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-06-01' AND '2017-06-30' GROUP BY c.CategoryName ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 1
